findings.text: Biggest gain: Start to T1, +0.13 s for VER L16 over LEC L12. Reaches 3 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #2: T1, +0.12 s for VER L16 over LEC L12. Brakes 13 m earlier, carries 6 km/h more minimum speed.
Gain #3: T11, +0.10 s for LEC L12 over VER L16. Brakes 8 m later, carries 9 km/h more minimum speed.
Gain #4: T9, +0.07 s for LEC L12 over VER L16. Brakes 7 m earlier, carries 2 km/h less minimum speed, exits 11 km/h faster.
Gain #5: T8, +0.06 s for LEC L12 over VER L16. Brakes 11 m later, gets on the throttle 9 m earlier.
